title: On Quantified Modal Theorem Proving for Modeling Ethics
reasoning: The paper's central theme is the use of formal logics, specifically a quantified modal logic called the deontic cognitive event calculus (DCEC), to model a range of ethical theories and principles. It explicitly discusses modeling the Doctrine of Double Effect, akrasia, and virtue ethics to enable automated ethical reasoning in autonomous systems. The entire work is dedicated to the formalization of ethics, not just a brief mention.
